verified: Toyota confirmed the Highlander 9X as its first EREV with an early-2027 on-sale date and named Huawei and CATL as technology suppliers, Electrek reported.
unconfirmed: range, battery capacity, power output, price, target markets, and exactly which components Huawei and CATL will supply; no independent testing or production-model specifications exist yet.

verified: 据 Electrek 报道，丰田确认汉兰达 9X 将于 2027 年初上市，是丰田首款增程式电动车，并使用华为与宁德时代的技术。
unconfirmed: 电池容量、纯电续航、动力参数、售价、首发市场，以及华为与宁德时代各自供应的具体部件均未公布；也没有第三方测试或量产车验证。

titles.en: Toyota confirms Highlander 9X as its first EREV, on sale early 2027
titles.zh: 丰田确认汉兰达9X于2027年初上市，成为品牌首款增程电动车
